macro_drivers.reason: Ongoing frictions between the US and China regarding forced labor, supply chain integrity, and strategic security in Asia.
Research highlights the significant economic costs of the Sino-American trade war and efforts by firms to decouple supply chains.

risks: Supply chain disruptions resulting from US policies targeting Xinjiang goods.
Political instability in Latin America following changes in leadership in Chile.
Increased geopolitical volatility in the Asia-Pacific region.
